lessons.incident_trigger: Memory exhaustion during batch processing of 100+ page PDF files
lessons.root_cause: Unbounded PDF image rasterization buffer in OCR worker
lessons.remediation_taken: Restarted worker & increased container memory limit from 1Gi to 2Gi
lessons.preventive_policy_update: Introduced streaming chunk-based PDF rasterization & memory cap policy

lessons.incident_trigger: Gemini API 429 quota exhaustion during morning document batch peak
lessons.root_cause: Static concurrency limit exceeded burst allowance
lessons.remediation_taken: Rerouted 40% traffic to secondary region via circuit breaker
lessons.preventive_policy_update: Implemented adaptive exponential backoff with multi-region proactive load balancer

lessons.incident_trigger: Redis connection timeouts under high worker concurrency
lessons.root_cause: Redis connection pool starvation due to idle connections not reaping
lessons.remediation_taken: Evicted stale connection pool handles and doubled max pool size
lessons.preventive_policy_update: Configured active health check keepalives and aggressive connection pool reaper
